root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: The `DICT_FREE` free-arm predicate must be false for the tracked borrowed attribute-name pointer before cleanup decides to free `cur->name`.
root_cause_criterion.criterion: When `xmlFreeProp()` evaluates `DICT_FREE(cur->name)` for the tracked balanced-chunk attribute, cleanup must not classify that borrowed dict-backed name as heap-freeable.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original reaches `xmlFreeProp()` with `free_arm_enabled = 1` for the tracked borrowed attribute name. The authoritative fixed image avoids this root event entirely via the upstream `xmlParseReference()` guard added at `parser.c:7129`, so this root criterion remained unverified in the fixed original.

nodes.state: In the `ctxt->dictNames` balanced-chunk attribute path, the temporary attribute keeps the borrowed parser-dictionary name pointer as `ret->name`.
The `DICT_FREE` free arm forwards the tracked `cur->name` pointer into `xmlFree()` at the AddressSanitizer-reported bad-free sink.

edges.relation: The borrowed attribute-name pointer chosen in the balanced-chunk `dictNames` path later reaches the `xmlFreeProp()` ownership check as the same `cur->name` value.
Once `xmlFreeProp()` misclassifies that tracked name as not owned by the current document dictionary, the same pointer is passed unchanged into the `xmlFree()` bad-free sink.
